command:
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, re, subprocess
root=Path.cwd(); stage=root/'logs/v0.2.1'
sha=lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
baseline=json.loads((stage/'input_hashes.json').read_text())
changed=[p for p,h in baseline.items() if not Path(p).exists() or sha(Path(p))!=h]
assert not changed,changed
print('Protected inputs unchanged:',len(baseline))
assert (root/'PROGRESS.md').read_bytes().endswith((stage/'before_PROGRESS.md').read_bytes())
print('Previous PROGRESS retained byte-for-byte.')
def uncomment(text):
    result=[]; i=0; depth=0
    while i<len(text):
        if text.startswith('/-',i): depth+=1; i+=2
        elif depth and text.startswith('-/',i): depth-=1; i+=2
        elif depth:
            if text[i]=='\n': result.append('\n')
            i+=1
        elif text.startswith('--',i):
            j=text.find('\n',i); i=len(text) if j<0 else j
        else: result.append(text[i]); i+=1
    assert depth==0
    return ''.join(result)
modules=sorted((root/'LeanPML').rglob('*.lean'))
formal=modules+[root/'LeanPML.lean',root/'Audit.lean']
assert len(modules)==8 and len(formal)==10
names=[]; counts={}
for f in formal:
    code=uncomment(f.read_text())
    assert not re.search(r'\b(sorry|admit|sorryAx|axiom)\b',code),f
    local=re.findall(r'^theorem (\w+)',code,re.M)
    namespaces=re.findall(r'^namespace (\S+)\s*$',code,re.M)
    if local:
        assert len(namespaces)==1,(f,namespaces)
        names.extend(namespaces[0]+'.'+n for n in local)
    counts[str(f.relative_to(root))]=len(local)
    assert (root/'.lake/build/lib/lean'/f.relative_to(root).with_suffix('.olean')).exists(),f
assert len(names)==len(set(names))==91
assert counts['LeanPML/PML/Coefficients.lean']==17
assert counts['LeanPML/PML/Weights.lean']==15
print('Formal theorem counts:',json.dumps(counts,ensure_ascii=False))
newdefs=sum(len(re.findall(r'^(?:noncomputable )?def ',uncomment((root/'LeanPML/PML'/f).read_text()),re.M)) for f in ['Coefficients.lean','Weights.lean'])
assert newdefs==12
audited=re.findall(r'^#print axioms (\S+)',uncomment((root/'Audit.lean').read_text()),re.M)
assert len(audited)==len(set(audited))==91 and set(audited)==set(names)
imports=set(re.findall(r'^import (\S+)',(root/'LeanPML.lean').read_text(),re.M))
assert imports=={'.'.join(f.relative_to(root).with_suffix('').parts) for f in modules}
assert 'defaultTargets = ["LeanPML", "Audit"]' in (root/'lakefile.toml').read_text()
print('Build/audit coverage: 8 modules, 10 .olean entries, 91 theorems (32 new), 12 new definitions.')
expected=[
('20261010T164047_677105_weights_check',1,['lake','env','lean','LeanPML/PML/Weights.lean']),
('20261010T164214_705177_lake_build_final',0,['lake','build']),
('20261010T164229_853015_axioms_audit',0,['lake','env','lean','Audit.lean'])]
outputs={}
for stem,exit_code,command in expected:
    m=json.loads((stage/(stem+'.json')).read_text())
    assert m['command']==command and m['cwd']==str(root)
    assert m['status']=='finished' and m['exit_code']==exit_code
    outputs[stem]=(stage/m['output_file']).read_text()
    print(stem,'exit=',exit_code,'command=',m['command_display'],'cwd=',m['cwd'])
build=outputs[expected[1][0]]
assert 'Build completed successfully (2119 jobs).' in build
assert 'warning:' not in build
audit=outputs[expected[2][0]]
entries=re.findall(r"'([^']+)' depends on axioms: \[([^\]]*)\]",audit)
assert len(entries)==91 and {n for n,_ in entries}==set(names)
standard={'propext','Classical.choice','Quot.sound'}
assert all({a.strip() for a in axs.split(',')}==standard for _,axs in entries)
assert 'sorryAx' not in audit
print('All independent audit outputs have only propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound; no placeholders.')
manifest=json.loads((root/'lake-manifest.json').read_text())
for pkg in manifest['packages']:
    actual=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(root/'.lake/packages'/pkg['name']),'rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
    assert actual==pkg['rev'],pkg['name']
print('All',len(manifest['packages']),'dependency revisions match the preserved manifest.')
for file in ['LocalElectric.lean','LocalDebye.lean']:
    assert not (root/'LeanPML/PML'/file).exists()
print('v0.2.2 modules not created.')
for filename in ['README.md','PROGRESS.md','docs/v0.2.1_reading_guide.md']:
    f=root/filename; text=f.read_text()
    if filename=='PROGRESS.md': text=text.split('---\n\n以下为此前进度原文')[0]
    assert len(re.findall(r'^\s*\$\$\s*$',text,re.M))%2==0,filename
    assert len(re.findall(r'^~~~',text,re.M))%2==0,filename
    assert '¤' not in text and '{{COMMAND_TABLE}}' not in text,filename
    for target in re.findall(r'\[[^\]]+\]\(([^)]+)\)',text):
        target=target.strip('<>').split('#',1)[0]
        if re.match(r'https?://',target): continue
        target=re.sub(r':\d+$','',target)
        assert (f.parent/target).exists(),(filename,target)
print('New docs links and math/code delimiters checked.')
guide=(root/'docs/v0.2.1_reading_guide.md').read_text()
for name,path,line in [
('Real.sqrt_pos','Analysis/Real/Sqrt.lean',286),('Real.sq_sqrt','Analysis/Real/Sqrt.lean',178),
('le_min_iff','Order/MinMax.lean',34),('lt_min_iff','Order/MinMax.lean',46),
('lt_min','Order/Defs/LinearOrder.lean',201),
('le_div_iff₀','Algebra/Order/GroupWithZero/Basic.lean',1134),
('div_le_iff₀','Algebra/Order/GroupWithZero/Basic.lean',1138),
('div_lt_iff₀','Algebra/Order/GroupWithZero/Basic.lean',1146),
('div_le_div_iff₀','Algebra/Order/GroupWithZero/Basic.lean',1430),
('mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left','Algebra/Order/GroupWithZero/Defs.lean',226),
('exists_nat_gt','Algebra/Order/Archimedean/Defs.lean',76)]:
    source=root/'.lake/packages/mathlib/Mathlib'/path
    assert name.split('.')[-1] in source.read_text().splitlines()[line-1],(name,path,line)
    assert name in guide
print('11 cited mathlib lemma names verified at the exact documented source lines.')
files=formal+[root/f for f in ['README.md','docs/v0.2.1_reading_guide.md','lean-toolchain','lakefile.toml','lake-manifest.json','scripts/run_logged.py']]
(stage/'verified_artifact_hashes.json').write_text(json.dumps({str(f.relative_to(root)):sha(f) for f in files},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Saved verified_artifact_hashes.json for compiled formal sources, README, guide and fixed configs.')
print('v0.2.1 final checks passed.')
